components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:320px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:22px; border:1px solid var(--border-c, #e4e9f1); background:var(--surface, #fff); color:var(--foreground, #182437); font-family:Inter, Arial, sans-serif; transition:all .3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-6px); box-shadow:0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-card__media { position:relative; aspect-ratio:1/1; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #0b1730, #0f1e3c 50%, #3f6bb0); } .ds-card__level { position:absolute; left:14px; top:14px; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:9999px; background:#fff; color:#3f6bb0; font:700 12px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-card__price { position:absolute; right:14px; top:14px; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:9999px; background:#0f1e3c; color:#fff; font:700 13px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card__body { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; padding:22px; } .ds-card__meta { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:14px; color:var(--ink-soft, #55637a); font:600 12.5px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card__title { margin:0; font:700 19px/1.3 Poppins, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card__text { margin:0; color:var(--ink-soft, #55637a); font:400 14px/1.6 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card__actions { display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:8px; } .ds-card__ghost, .ds-card__primary { flex:1; min-height:44px; border-radius:9999px; border:2px solid var(--border-c, #e4e9f1); background:transparent; color:inherit; font:600 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:all .3s ease; } .ds-card__ghost:hover { border-color:#6f9bd4; color:#3f6bb0; } .ds-card__primary { border-color:transparent; background:#4f7fbf; color:#fff; } .ds-card__primary:hover { background:#0f1e3c; }

components.css: .ds-band { position:relative; overflow:hidden; width:560px; padding:48px 40px; border-radius:22px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #0b1730, #0f1e3c 55%, #3f6bb0); color:#fff; font-family:Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-band__orb { position:absolute; border-radius:9999px; filter:blur(60px); background:rgba(111,155,212,0.35); animation:ds-float 14s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-band__orb--a { right:-80px; top:-100px; width:320px; height:320px; } .ds-band__orb--b { left:-60px; bottom:-80px; width:240px; height:240px; animation-delay:-6s; } @keyframes ds-float { 0%,100% { transform:translate(0,0) scale(1); } 50% { transform:translate(-30px,30px) scale(1.08); } } .ds-band__content { position:relative; z-index:1; } .ds-band__eyebrow { display:inline-flex; padding:6px 14px; margin-bottom:18px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color:#cfe0f8; font:700 13px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-band__title { margin:0 0 14px; font:700 38px/1.15 Poppins, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-band__title em { font-style:normal; color:#6f9bd4; } .ds-band__text { margin:0 0 28px; max-width:420px; color:#c6d3ea; font:400 17px/1.6 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-band__actions { display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-band__primary, .ds-band__outline { min-height:52px; padding:14px 28px; border-radius:9999px; border:2px solid transparent; font:600 15px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:all .3s ease; } .ds-band__primary { background:#4f7fbf; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-band__primary:hover { background:#0f1e3c; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-band__outline { background:transparent; border-color:#fff; color:#fff; } .ds-band__outline:hover { background:#fff; color:#0f1e3c; transform:translateY(-2px); }

narrative.overview:
Reemora looks like a well-lit workshop run by someone who ships. Deep navy is the ground the studio stands on: it carries the hero, the footer, the admin frame and every dark-mode surface, and it signals seriousness without coldness. One blue does all the pointing. It is the only colour that asks for a click, so when it appears the eye already knows what to do. Everything else is white, haze-blue panels and hairline borders, which keeps the member's own work (screenshots, projects, chat) as the brightest thing on the page.

The system is tactile and confident. Controls are pills with real weight that lift a few pixels on hover; cards sit flat on the page and rise with a soft shadow only when touched. Density is comfortable rather than tight: sections breathe at 64 to 96 pixels, content maxes out at 1180 pixels, and body copy never drops below 15 pixels. Arabic is a first-class rendering, not a translation layer: the whole page switches to Tajawal with extra line height and mirrors through logical properties.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight navy ground, one Signal Blue for action, white and haze panels for content.
Pill-shaped controls everywhere; 22px radius for cards, 12px for inputs and small panels.
Flat at rest, lifted on interaction: shadows are a response, never a default.
Poppins headings, Inter body, Tajawal for Arabic, with RTL handled by logical properties.
Comfortable rhythm: 1180px container, 64/96px section padding, 44px minimum touch targets.
Dark mode is a re-skin of the same tokens, not a second design.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only colour that means "act". It never decorates: no blue section backgrounds on light pages, no blue body text, no blue icons at rest.

rules.name: The Navy Ground Rule
rules.body: Navy is a surface, not a text colour. Dark panels (hero, CTA band, footer, link covers) carry white text and blue accents; light panels carry Ink.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every section headline on a marketing page is announced by an uppercase label chip (Blue Tint background, Signal Blue Deep text) above it. The chip, not a rule line or icon, is the section marker.

rules.name: The 16px Input Rule
rules.body: Inputs render at 16px on phones so iOS never zooms the viewport; visual sizes below that are allowed only above 640px.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No card, panel or input has a shadow at rest. Depth is earned by hover, focus or overlap.

dos: Do use Signal Blue for exactly one action per view; everything else is Ghost or Navy.
Do keep every interactive element a pill, 44px tall on marketing pages and 40px in app UI.
Do start marketing sections with an eyebrow chip, then a Headline, then a 17px lead paragraph capped near 65 characters.
Do separate surfaces by tone and a 1px Hairline, and reserve shadows for hover and overlap.
Do write layout with logical properties so Arabic mirrors correctly, and test every surface in both languages and both themes.
Do let member work be the brightest thing on the page: full-bleed screenshots, white cards, muted chrome.
donts: Don't add a blue section background, blue body text or blue icons at rest on light pages.
Don't put a shadow on a card, panel or input at rest.
Don't introduce a third brand colour or a new accent for emphasis; use weight, size and Signal Blue.
Don't mix corner radii inside one component; images take the container's clip, never their own radius.
Don't drop body copy below 15px or inputs below 16px on phones.
Don't use a second display face or decorative type; Poppins and Inter (Tajawal in Arabic) are the full set.
